_comment: Tool schema for the record_award tool gated by award_threshold.cedar. The amount parameter MUST be declared integer, not number. A parameter typed number reaches Cedar as a string, and the comparison context.input.amount <= 50000 then silently denies by default. This is the most common cause of a Cedar policy that looks correct but rejects valid requests.
name: record_award
description: Record an approved benefits award for a case

case_id.description: Case reference in the system of record

amount.description: Award amount in whole currency units. Declared integer so Cedar evaluates it numerically.

program.description: Benefits program the award applies to: housing, food_assistance, or energy
